messages:
Maya (PM): Hey team — dropping the latest mock for the Autoscaling & Capacity Controls panel: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/autoscale-controls. TL;DR: min/max instances, burst toggle (burst pool selection), GPU pool dropdown, SLO slider (latency ms p95), soft/hard guardrails, save & preview. PTAL before design review tomorrow.
Alex (Design): Saw it — nice direction. A few copy/layout nits: change 'min instances' -> 'Minimum capacity (GPUs)'; add helper text under burst: 'Temporary extra capacity, billed separately'. Move the SLO slider above guardrails and show a tiny inline cost estimate.
Priya (Frontend): Accessibility notes: slider needs keyboard focus + aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow; add visible focus ring; ensure disabled contrast meets AA. Also add a small numeric input next to the slider for precise values. If GPU pool lists get long, prefer autosuggest over a giant dropdown.
Diego (Infra): Backend semantics questions: does "burst" spin up a separate pool or borrow from existing pools? I'd prefer a separate "burst" pool with a configurable cap + duration to avoid noisy neighbor issues. Also we should expose guardrails as policy objects the control plane enforces.
Sam (Eng Manager): +1 on telemetry. We need events for: min/max updates, burst toggle + cap, pool switches, SLO slider changes, guardrail edits, and any guardrail breaches. Rollout plan: feature flag -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with ops alerting on breaches. Who owns the telemetry schema?
Alex (Design): Copy tweak: replace ambiguous 'SLO' label with 'Latency SLO (p95 ms)' and add a tooltip with examples. For guardrails, show soft vs hard visually: soft = warn (yellow), hard = block (red).
Maya (PM): @Priya can you mock keyboard flows and attach a short a11y checklist? @Diego can you confirm API shape and whether burst requires separate pool provisioning? I'll capture answers in the RFC. Also, add a small 'preview estimated cost' CTA under controls.
Priya (Frontend): Yep — will mock keyboard flows and attach a11y checklist. I'll prototype the slider component and numeric fallback. Plan to open a small PR for the component soon.
Diego (Infra): Confirmed: burst will map to a logical "burst" pool which may be backed by separate nodes. I'll draft API proposal today: suggested shape below for guardrail policy.
```
{"policy_id":"p-guard-1","type":"hard","metric":"latency_ms","threshold":"200"}
```
Sam (Eng Manager): Also, add metrics for perceived latency vs SLO and a dashboard tile for "guardrail health" (counts of soft warnings vs hard blocks). We'll need alert thresholds before wider rollout.
autoscale-bot: feature-flag "capacity-ui-redesign" created -> env:staging.
Maya (PM): Great. Follow-ups: add 'save as preset' affordance, show preset list in the dropdown, and include 'burst duration' field (minutes). Let's review the updated mock tomorrow at 10:30am. :calendar:
